title: Sunset at the Lighthouse
description: Every sunset for nearly a year, Erin waits at the lighthouse for Lyndsey to return. As another day fades into darkness, a familiar whistle carries across the ocean.
excerpt: Erin promised she would wait at the lighthouse every sunset until Lyndsey returned. Nearly a year later, as the last light disappears beneath the ocean, she finally hears something familiar on the wind.
author: from-a-storyteller
